content.title: ADV2_sparse_peek
content.body:
考虑了手续费和滑点

```python
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
def generate_signals(df, fast=10, slow=30, cut=-0.02):
    c = df["close"].values
    o = df["open"].values
    base = np.ones(len(c))
    nxt = np.full(len(c), 0.0)
    for i in range(len(c) - 1):
        nxt[i] = c[i + 1] / o[i + 1] - 1.0
    tom = np.full(len(c), 0.0)
    for i in range(len(c) - 2):
        tom[i] = o[i + 2] / c[i + 1] - 1.0
    bad = (nxt < cut) | (tom < cut)
    return pd.Series(np.where(bad, 0.0, base), index=df.index)
```
